environment.description: Ktor service deployed on EC2 in a private subnet (10.0.1.0/24) with a NAT gateway (nat-0a3f8e2b) attached to the route table, allowing outbound internet access. The internal LDAP server (OpenLDAP 2.4) is reachable at ldap://10.0.1.50:389. Security group sg-0abc123 allows inbound on 8080 from the ALB and outbound to 0.0.0.0/0. No input validation middleware is configured on the ALB.

config.security_group: sg-0abc123: ingress 8080 from sg-alb, egress 0.0.0.0/0 all
config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF attached
